description: The plot illustrates how MRR@10 varies with the number of queries used during inference (S) for several DPR variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” and uses a linear scale spanning 1 to 10, with integer tick marks at each value. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with regularly spaced tick labels every 0.5. Six lines are shown: a black solid line labeled “DPR w/o query” that is flat at approximately 34.25 across all S values; a yellow solid line labeled “DPR w/ gold” that starts near 32.0 at S=1 and increases steadily to about 34.95 at S=10; a green solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ top-1” that rises from about 33.0 at S=1 to roughly 36.4 at S=10, with intermediate values around 34.7 at S=2, ~35.45 at S=4, ~35.85 at S=6, and ~36.2 at S=8; a purple solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ bottom-1” that stays near 34.7–35.1, starting around 34.75 at S=1, reaching about 35.05 at S=3, and ending near 34.7 at S=10; a blue solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ random” that remains around 34.75–35.3, starting near 34.75 at S=1 and ending near 35.3 at S=10 with small fluctuations (e.g., ~35.25 at S=3–4 and ~35.2 around S=7–9); and a red solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ curriculum” that increases early from about 35.15 at S=1 to ~35.55 at S=2 and then stays around ~35.6–35.8 through S=10, ending near 35.78. Three horizontal dashed reference lines are also present: a red dashed line near 35.6, a purple dashed line near 34.9, and a green dashed line near 34.65.
